Name: Pride Flag Shirts for Fashion Sense
Author: NoraCharles
Description:
Celebrate Pride Month with new shirts for your farmer! This is a content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url], so the shirts are available with the Hand Mirror tool -- please see the Fashion Sense mod description for details on how to use it.

The collection now includes[b] 31 Pride flags[/b] as of version 1.1.0! Most flags are available on black, gray, and white shirts, as well as a baseball tee (usually white or gray with black sleeves), for a total of 135 shirts.

The shirts are organized by flag type within the mod folder, so you can delete any subfolders that you don't want.

The following Pride flags are currently included:
[list]
[*]Abrosexual
[*]Agender (NEW in v1.1.0)
[*]Aroace
[*]Aromantic
[*]Asexual
[*]Bigender (NEW in v1.1.0)
[*]Bisexual
[*]Demiboy (NEW in v1.1.0)
[*]Demigirl (NEW in v1.1.0)
[*]Demiromantic
[*]Demisexual
[*]Gay Men
[*]Genderfluid
[*]Genderqueer
[*]Gray Ace
[*]Intersex
[*]Lesbian
[*]LGBTQ+ (the classic rainbow flag)
[*]Nonbinary
[*]Omnisexual
[*]Pangender (NEW in v1.1.0)
[*]Pansexual
[*]Philly (POC-inclusive rainbow flag from Philadelphia) (NEW in v1.1.0)
[*]Placiosexual/Placioromantic (NEW in v1.1.0)
[*]Polyamory (3 different flag designs as of v1.1.0)
[*]Polysexual
[*]Queer (NEW in v1.1.0)
[*]Transgender
[*]Transfemme (NEW in v1.1.0)
[*]Transmasc (NEW in v1.1.0)
[*]Xenogender (NEW in v1.1.0)
[/list]I might add more shirts in the future, so let me know if your flag is missing! I will add as many as I can, although some Pride flags are quite complex so it will be a challenge to fit them on an 8x8-pixel shirt! I might add more styles as well.

You may also like my mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25049]Pride Flag Butterflies[/url]!


[b]MY OTHER MODS[/b]

Check out [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/NoraCharles/mods?gameId=1303]my other mods for Stardew Valley[/url], which include maps, animals, crops, furniture, clothing, and more!
All donation points earned by my mods go to [url=https://www.doctorswithoutborders.org/]Doctors Without Borders[/url].

Downloads.Description:
Requires Fashion Sense

v1.1.0: Added at least 1 shirt per flag, including a new flag variant for Polyamory. Added 11 new flags (Agender, Bigender, Demiboy, Demigirl, Pangender, Philly, Placiosexual/romantic, Queer, Transfemme, Transmasc, Xenogender).
